scripts.backend: cd backend && dotnet watch run --urls http://localhost:8080
scripts.dev: npm run services && echo 'Infrastructure started! Now run: npm run backend (in one terminal) and npm run frontend (in another terminal)'
scripts.dev:setup: npm run services && echo 'Waiting for services...' && powershell -Command "Start-Sleep 5" && echo 'Services ready! Use Ctrl+Shift+P -> Tasks: Run Task -> Development Setup'
scripts.test: npm run backend:test && npm run frontend:test
scripts.build: npm run backend:build && npm run frontend:build
scripts.prod:down: wsl docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down --rmi local
scripts.clean: wsl docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml down -v && wsl docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down -v
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run services
